backtest_protocol.execution_model: Before: current accepted allocator with exp-032 laggard/revision and exp-001 peer_shock source_notional_scalars. After: same source selection with only turn_of_month added at 1.25x paper notional. PnL is recomputed from selected row pnl_pct_net and scaled notional.
backtest_protocol.source: docs/backtesting.md canonical three-window core replay plus shared accepted-helper source-priority allocator overlay

runtime_fields: daily snapshot candidate source_notional_scalar if accepted

gate3.note: Default-off paper notional only; core signals/survival unchanged.

hypothesis: allocation: selected turn_of_month rows in the accepted helper allocator may deserve a small default-off paper notional scalar because the corrected accepted-sleeve independence map shows positive standalone turn-of-month returns and the current allocator still selects turn_of_month rows across all three canonical windows after laggard, revision, and peer-shock source scalars.
interpretation: Turn-of-month source notional improved the current accepted allocator and should be retained only as shared default-off paper observation.
next_retry_requires: no frozen-window turn_of_month source scalar sweep

post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retry by sweeping turn_of_month scalar, source rank, allocator top-N, hold days, cooldown, calendar day labels, ret20/ret60 thresholds, close-location, volume, or volatility guards on the frozen windows.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: Closed forward allocator replacement-value rows tagged by turn_of_month source family, or a materially new out-of-sample source independence surface.
post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The corrected turn_of_month independence signal translated into incremental after-arbitration paper capital without changing selection.

pre_run_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: allocation: selected turn_of_month rows in the accepted helper allocator may deserve a small default-off paper notional scalar because the corrected accepted-sleeve independence map shows positive standalone turn-of-month returns and the current allocator still selects turn_of_month rows across all three canonical windows after laggard, revision, and peer-shock source scalars.

2_history_check.exp-20260609-027: Accepted turn-of-month liquid leadership as a shared default-off paper adapter. This run keeps the source definition fixed.
2_history_check.exp-20260620-032: Accepted 1.25x source-notional scalars for selected industry_laggard_repair and revision_surprise_low_extension rows.
2_history_check.exp-20260620-033: Corrected independence map: turn_of_month had 45 harness trades, mean net return 2.179%, total PnL $3,921.56, mean abs correlation 0.094, and mean ticker-date overlap 0.0161.
2_history_check.exp-20260621-001: Accepted the same 1.25x scalar for selected rolling_peer_shock rows; this run keeps that before state fixed.
2_history_check.exp-20260621-004: Rejected volatility_relief scalar because the current allocator selected zero volatility_relief rows after arbitration.
2_history_check.novelty_gate: experiment.py new warned on allocator/revision near-neighbors. The override is the corrected accepted-sleeve independence map plus current after-arbitration turn_of_month selected rows across all three canonical windows; this is not a calendar threshold, hold, cooldown, source-rank, or standalone turn-of-month notional retry.

pre_run_questions.3_single_causal_variable: One fixed policy bundle: add source_notional_scalar=1.25 for selected turn_of_month allocator rows, while accepted laggard/revision/peer-shock scalars, source selection, rank, daily top-1, hold, costs, cooldown, core behavior, LLM/news, and live/default orders remain fixed.
pre_run_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Use docs/backtesting.md canonical three windows. Before is the current accepted allocator including exp-032 and exp-001 source scalars; after adds only turn_of_month 1.25x. Accept only if aggregate EV/PnL improve, no window EV/PnL regression, affected turn_of_month sample spans all three windows with >=20 rows, survival/concentration/drawdown guards pass, and the after allocator still beats accepted comparators.

prediction.confidence_reason: Mechanism is capital allocation to an already selected accepted allocator source rather than changing source rank or adding tickers. Corrected exp-20260620-033 shows turn_of_month has positive standalone PnL but higher overlap than laggard/revision/peer, so success odds are modest and the main risk is that calendar-flow rows are redundant after current source arbitration.

execution_envelope.cash_management_note: idle bucket cash may sit in the accepted low-deployment ETF substitute at operator level; not part of sleeve trade policy
execution_envelope.kill_switch_calibration_note: 15pct is about 1.5x the worst healthy-window giveback (about 10pct of peak equity in late_strong); calibrated on frozen windows, so the in-sample no-false-trigger check is partially circular and the binding validation is OOS plus genuine forward rows (exp-20260612-024)
execution_envelope.slippage_model: entry/exit 5bps plus ROUND_TRIP_COST_PCT per quant/fill_model.py and quant/constants.py; conservative for 4k USD orders above the ADV floor

production_impact.parity_note: If accepted, historical replay and daily default-off snapshots use the same shared accepted-helper allocator source_notional_scalars. If rejected, no shared helper, run adapter, daily snapshot, live orders, or core behavior changes are retained.
